title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF&39;s support enhanced NICU services, healthcare worker skills, community engagement, and efforts to eliminate HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis. Over 140,846 pregnant women received first-visit antenatal care, 70,629 received fourth-visit care (7 per cent increase from 2023), and facility deliveries rose by 1 per cent to 93,447.
